name: Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences
summary: Amsterdam hogeschool with four English bachelor's: International Business (with a 3-year fast track), fashion at AMFI, physiotherapy and sport.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is on AUAS's list of accepted diplomas, including for the VWO-level International Business fast track. English at B2: a diploma taught completely in English in the EU can count as proof.

dates.label: Deadline for international students who need a study visa

programmes.name: AMFI - Amsterdam Fashion Institute (English programme)
programmes.ib: Numerus fixus: apply by 15 January 2027; places go by a ranked assignment, video and form. Any IB Diploma subjects; English at B2.
programmes.about: Fashion from designing and making garments to branding and selling them, with a specialisation in Fashion & Design, Fashion & Branding or Fashion & Management and hands-on industry projects.
programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus, 440 places: a 5-10 page assignment, a video answering set questions and a form, due about two weeks after you apply; ranked, results 15 April.

programmes.name: AMSIB - International Business
programmes.ib: One of Maths AA or AI, Business Management or Economics (SL or HL). A 3-year fast track, also a BBA, takes VWO-level diplomas such as the IB.
programmes.about: A broad international business degree with five majors, such as International Marketing and Sales or Global Business Communication, plus a compulsory exchange, internship and thesis.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027.

programmes.name: European School of Physiotherapy
programmes.ib: Numerus fixus (100 places): apply by 15 January 2027; written exam and interview. VWO-level diploma; English at IELTS 6.5 or equivalent.
programmes.about: An intensive three-year physiotherapy degree in English that mixes science, practical skills and clinical internships in varied healthcare settings, taught in small international groups.
programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus, 100 places: a written exam and an interview with an ESP lecturer rank you. Biology and chemistry are recommended, not required.

programmes.name: Sport Studies (track ISMB)
programmes.ib: Numerus fixus (96 places): apply by 15 January 2027; selection by a video and an online interview with an oral exam. Sport medical exam (€130) before you start.
programmes.about: Management and business applied to sport, with entrepreneurial projects and three internships at international sport organisations over the four years.
programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus: a video showing your motor skills and motivation, then an online interview with an oral exam, set your ranking number. Sport medical exam before you start.

notes: Applicants with a non-Dutch diploma pay a €100 application fee; EU/EEA students who are accepted and enrol get it back in November 2027.
Three of the four English bachelor's (AMFI, Physiotherapy, Sport Studies) have a numerus fixus, so you must apply by 15 January 2027 and pass a selection.
The International Business fast track awards the same BBA in three years, with a more academic, faster-paced delivery.
